top_story.title: These Stocks Are Today’s Movers: Coinbase, AMD, Palantir, Tesla, eBay, GameStop, FedEx, UPS, Micron, and More
top_story.summary: STOCKSTOWATCHTODAY BLOG  Stocks fell Monday and oil prices rose after the United Arab Emirates’ Ministry of Defense said it detected four missiles coming from Iran. Earlier, the U.S. military’s Central Command denied a report that Iran had struck an American warship in the Strait of Hormuz.
